name: Illvoi
description: A species of large gelatinous medusaform beings from a gas giant, living in the Edge and members of Pinnacle.

description_citations.text: "Illvoi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The damaged ship slips past the sentries disguised as storm debris.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros" by AnaMaria Curtis. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Three Illvoi on hovering chairs pass beneath the hidden pair, and one waves a tentacle without raising an alarm.
timeline.quote: Three Illvoi ride by, each perched delicately on their hovering chairs.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros" by AnaMaria Curtis. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: An Illvoi researcher opens a wall terminal; Rezint glimpses it before the researcher leaves.
timeline.quote: an Illvoi comes out from the side passage they're about to move to and taps something in the wall.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros" by AnaMaria Curtis. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: An Illvoi ship arrives beside the Seriema.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The Illvoi extend a superfluid helium bubble around the Seriema.
timeline.quote: they snug their ship up close and extend their helium bubble around Sami's ship.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Illvoi mechans cool the Seriema and begin repairing its fusion drive.
timeline.quote: Then the mechans swarm over the Seriema 's stern to repair the fusion drive.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The Illvoi build vessels and travel to the stars, where they meet Pinnacle and join it.

citation.text: "Illvoi", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Illvoi mechanics under Mm'menon repair the Seriema's fusion drive.
timeline.quote: Her fusion drive was subsequently repaired by Illvoi mechanics under Mm'menon

citation.text: "Seriema", section "Condition". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Uthros Combine builds a research complex as cover for a secret installation at the planet's core, where a possible eldrazi titan's corpse has been studied for about 92 years.
timeline.quote: It has been studied for at least 33,507 cycles

citation.text: "Uthros", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
